evidence.title: GitHub - shadcn-labs/pdfcn: Beautiful pdf components, built on Takumi and Forme. 100% Free, Zero config, one command setup. · GitHub

name: pdfcn
summary: Copy-paste PDF components for React: Takumi and Forme primitives, invoice and report blocks, installed with the shadcn CLI.
description: Free, open-source PDF components for React built on the Takumi and Forme renderers and distributed through a shadcn registry. The docs cover printable primitives — alert, badge, card, data table, form, graph, QR code, watermark and more — plus ready-made blocks from invoices and reports to packing slips, and nine theme presets.
contains: 24 Takumi PDF primitives (alert, badge, card, data table, form, graph, QR code, watermark…)
20 blocks: six invoice styles, four reports, meeting minutes, packing slip, shipping label, work order…
two rendering bases: Takumi and Forme
nine theme presets (Professional, Modern, Minimal, Executive, Corporate, Elegant, Vivid, Forest, Blueprint)
installs via shadcn CLI, MCP server or copy-paste; an agent skill ships with the docs
